column1: # The inputs MirrorDock is built from, one per line, fields separated by one tab.
# No field is empty: "-" stands where one has nothing to say.  (No semicolon and
# no square bracket anywhere in this file: CMake reads it as a list.)
#   kind        library   linked into the program
#               system    parts of Windows it calls
#               run_time  fetched when the program needs it
#               credit    work it is built on without containing it
#   check       the key under which win_native/CMakeLists.txt knows the version
#               this build really uses (then that version is the one shown, and
#               a date or revision recorded here for another version is left out)
#   version     recorded when the input was pinned
#   revision    the commit that is built
#   date        of that commit, or of the tool's package (ISO 8601)
#   licence     SPDX identifier where there is one
#   repository  where fetch_deps.sh clones it from
#   directory   the directory fetch_deps.sh clones it into
# One list for three readers: fetch_deps.sh (repository, directory, revision),
# win_native/CMakeLists.txt (it becomes a table in the program) and README_AI.md
# ("Pinned inputs" describes it).  Observed 2026-11-12, see README_AI.md.

column2: Direct3D 11, DXGI, Direct2D, DirectWrite, WASAPI, WinHTTP
